name: aegis-grc
description: Aegis GRC — self-hosted ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control tracker (single encrypted file, single container).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
